sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Fellers is a leading supplier of signs and graphics, automotive films, and equipment.

Industry: Distribution · Size: $50M-$250M · Products: Signs & Graphics, Automotive Films, Equipment, Print Films, Overlaminates, Tapes

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Fellers scores 65 of 100 (tier B) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (12/30), application fit (25/25), company size (8/15) and event engagement (15/15).

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on graffiti resistance, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar's low-surface-energy face makes graffiti and overspray wipe off cleanly.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (56% similar on films, graphics, wrap, vehicle); Drytac (47% similar on films, print, graphics, film); Mactac (46% similar on films, print, film, graphics). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.
